sections.title: The Capstone of the Master Instructor Track
learningObjectives: Understand how this module synthesizes the full L5 skill set
Recognize why observed delivery, not a written test, is the final assessment
sections.content: Every prior L5 module built toward one outcome: actually delivering training effectively. L5 certification is validated through observed live delivery, not a written exam. That's consistent with this curriculum's broader principle that practical competency requires practical demonstration, not just knowledge recall.

sections.title: What Observed Delivery Involves
learningObjectives: Understand the general format of an observed delivery assessment
Recognize what's being evaluated during the observation
sections.content: An observed delivery assessment means an experienced evaluator - senior faculty, working alongside DiFacto - watches the candidate actually teach a real or representative session. What's being evaluated isn't just technical accuracy, but the pedagogical skills built throughout L5: structuring the session, checking for understanding, giving effective feedback, and managing the training environment.

sections.title: Preparing for Observed Delivery
learningObjectives: Understand how to prepare for this assessment format
Recognize the value of practice delivery before the formal assessment
sections.content: Preparation benefits from practice delivery - teaching the planned session to colleagues or in a low-stakes setting before the formal observed assessment, applying the feedback principles from L5-M1 to one's own developing instructional technique. Treating the first live delivery as the observed assessment itself, with no prior practice, raises unnecessary risk.

sections.title: The Evaluation Rubric
learningObjectives: Understand the general structure of the observed delivery evaluation
Recognize this as an application of the rubric design principles from L5-M2
sections.content: Observed delivery is evaluated against defined teaching competencies - a direct application of the rubric design principles covered in L5-M2, ensuring consistent evaluation regardless of which senior faculty member conducts the observation. Specific competency criteria will be confirmed as DiFacto's instructor certification process is finalized.

sections.title: Handling an Unsuccessful Observation
learningObjectives: Understand the general process if an observed delivery doesn't meet the certification bar
Recognize this as a developmental step, consistent with the re-sit policy used throughout the curriculum
sections.content: Consistent with the re-sit policy applied across other certification levels in this curriculum, an unsuccessful observed delivery isn't a final outcome - it's feedback, using the same principles from L5-M1, on specific areas to develop before a subsequent attempt. This mirrors the curriculum's broader philosophy that certification reflects genuine competency, worth the time to develop properly rather than rushing through.

sections.title: Becoming Part of DiFacto's Instructor Network
learningObjectives: Understand what DiFacto Master IMR Instructor certification enables
Recognize the ongoing role within DiFacto's training ecosystem
sections.content: Successfully completing observed delivery, alongside the preceding L5 modules, confers DiFacto Master IMR Instructor certification - jointly issued by DiFacto and senior faculty, keeping quality consistent across the instructor network. This certification enables training and certifying other MoRo users independently, making the certified instructor part of DiFacto's scaling mechanism for reaching customers and partners DiFacto's own team can't be present at every site to train directly.

questions.question: How is L5 certification validated, per the curriculum's assessment framework?
options: Observed live delivery, not a written test
questions.feedback: Correct. L5 certification is confirmed through observed delivery, consistent with practical competency requiring practical demonstration.

questions.question: What does an observed delivery assessment evaluate?
options: Both technical accuracy and pedagogical skills like structuring, understanding checks, and feedback
Only how long the session lasted
questions.feedback: Correct. Observed delivery evaluates the full range of teaching skills built throughout L5.

questions.question: Why is practice delivery recommended before the formal observed assessment?
options: It applies feedback principles to one's own technique, reducing risk in the first live delivery
Practice sessions count as the formal assessment
questions.feedback: Correct. Practicing beforehand reduces the risk of treating the formal assessment as the first attempt.

questions.question: What happens if an observed delivery doesn't meet the certification bar?
options: It's a final, unappealable failure with no path forward
It's treated as developmental feedback, consistent with the re-sit policy used elsewhere in the curriculum
The candidate is automatically certified anyway
questions.feedback: Correct. An unsuccessful observation is feedback for development, not a final outcome.

questions.question: What does DiFacto Master IMR Instructor certification enable?
options: Training and certifying other MoRo users, extending DiFacto's training reach
questions.feedback: Correct. Certified Master Instructors become part of DiFacto's scaling mechanism for training delivery.
